rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying or writing the letters of a word.

example.english: Do you know how to spell it?
example.jyutping: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 cyun3 zi6 aa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the magical words or formula themselves.

example.english: The wizard began chanting a spell to summon a dragon.
example.traditional: 巫師開始念咒語，想召喚巨龍。
example.jyutping: mou4 si1 hoi1 ci2 nim6 zau3 jyu5 soeng2 ziu6 wun6 geoi6 lung4

rows.note: Use this for a spell understood as an enchantment or magical effect placed on someone.

example.english: The spell took effect, and he fainted immediately.
example.traditional: 個魔咒生效了，佢即刻暈低。
example.jyutping: go3 mo1 zau3 sang1 haau6 liu5 keoi5 zik1 hak1 wan4 dai1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on the magical power or influence rather than the specific enchantment.

example.english: This necklace has so much spell power that I can fly after putting it on.
example.traditional: 呢條項鏈好有魔力，我戴咗之後就識飛喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 hong6 lin6 hou2 jau5 mo1 lik6 ngo5 daai3 zo2 zi1 hau6 zau6 sik1 fei1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone or something fascinates or bewitches a person and holds their attention.

example.english: This movie really has me under a spell.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 mai4 zyu6 zo2 ngo5
